test_name: Access Control - AC-3 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Mission-API-009
Primary NIST family: Access Control (AC); evidence focus: AC-3.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one read-only analytics role still contains a broader wildcard permission than the approved least-privilege baseline. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
